temperature_drift_description: 由 37°C 遞減至 35°C 後進入漸進過渡期，35°C 與 23°C 兩種概念交替出現，過渡點在第 14,028 筆，最後完全轉為 23°C 並平滑升至 27°C。
drift_times_format: [[t, t], ...] from published change points; empty if continuous

preprocessing: features + class from USP/River CSV (no header)
remap class labels to 0-based contiguous ids
write drift_times from Souza et al. 2020 Table 2
